main_text.l: & nunquā satis æstimanda appendice, possunt
& conjugationes verborum perfectorum me-
moriæ mandari: ac primo quidem tabella illa
tredecim Conjugationum, quam exhibet lib.
2. cap. 1. diligenter discenda est, eaque cogni-
tā, verba quædam alia trilitera, ut [illegible, ~3 letters] [illegible, ~3
letters] [illegible, ~3 letters] [illegible, ~3 letters] & alia quælibet
per eam diduci debent, ut oblatæ cujusque
radicis conjugationem quamlibet nullo negotio
formare discas. Hinc progrediendū ad Paradi-
gma primæ conjugationis Activæ, quod benè
memoriæ est imprimendum, cum ab eo reliqui
omnia dependeant: mox præcepta ei adjun-
cta legenda quoque & discenda sunt:
Deinde differentiæ conjugationum deriva-
tivarum à primâ, sequentibus duobus capitibus
traditæ, memoriæ quoque infigi debent, & ra-
dices plures per primas tantum temporum vo-
ces in prima conjugatione, & reliquis didu-
cendæ sunt; nec ante pergendum ad verba
imperfecta quàm perfectorum conjugationes o-
mnes tum primitivæ tum derivativæ benè per-
fectæ & cognitæ sint. Hinc ad imperfecta
fiat progressus, et singulis speciebus singuli
dentur dies, confusionis evitandæ gratiâ,
beneque considerentur, & memoriæ mandentur
generales imperfectionis rationes, quæ sub ini-
tium.

page.notes: The three Arabic words in the first paragraph (after "ut", and the line of "& alia quælibet") could not be read letter by letter and are marked illegible. Printed Arabic characters are not reproduced. Hyphenated line-end words were joined: cogni-tâ, ra-dicis, adjun-cta, per-fectæ, be-neque, ini-tium. The page has a printed "(79)" at the head and the gathering signature "G 4" at the foot. The word "tium" at the end of the last line is the second half of "initium", not a catchword.
